checks.detail: kernel enters at the hourly close; the live bot scans every 5 min on a forming candle, so the kernel reads pumps +0.55pp larger on average (184 matched setups). DECLARED LIMITATION: arena absolute WR is not live WR. Arm-vs-arm comparisons stay valid — all arms share this kernel — but a promoted arm must still survive the earlier live entry, and that caveat is attached to every surfaced verdict.

findings.claim: Checklist item arms_running reports 5 running arms and control_placebo reports both registered, framing the arena as producing live evidence.
findings.problem: Live sample counts are effectively zero: control live_n=3, hold-12h live_n=3, sl-5pct live_n=2, tp-7pct live_n=2, vol-4x live_n=2, entry-8pct live_n=1, against a confirm planned n=600. Every ranking in the arena block is therefore backfill screen evidence, yet arms are labelled [running/confirm] as if they were accumulating confirm-tier data. At measured ghost arrival of 25.5 control trades/day the live tape should be far past single digits, so either arms are not actually taking the trades they are credited with, or the live counter is measuring something other than what the label implies.

findings.claim: paired_population is green: 'every arm scored on identical events', 4785 events in the shared window.
findings.problem: The arm rows contradict this. screen_n differs sharply across arms — control/placebo 1535, hold-12h 1540, sl-5pct 1533, tp-7pct 1532, vol-4x 858, entry-8pct 494 — and hold-12h's 1540 exceeds control's 1535 even though max_hold_h=12 only shortens holds and cannot create detections. Sharing a detection stream is not the same as being scored on identical resolved trades, and the two arms with the largest screen_dWR (sl-5pct +5.22pp, hold-12h +3.19pp) are compared against a control with a different resolved-trade set. The checkbox certifies event parity and is being read as trade parity.

findings.claim: hold-12h screen_dWR=3.19pp and sl-5pct screen_dWR=5.22pp are presented as the leading arms.
findings.problem: Both deltas are quoted with no p-value, no discordant-pair counts (b/c) and no confidence interval, against corrected alpha=0.00833. The project's own kill record shows the format it demands: L-sl-entry-anchor was killed with 'paired p=9.18e-41, b=0/c=134, n=1474'. The two best-looking arms are reported without any of that, so nothing distinguishes them from max-of-6 selection noise (failure mode MT), and this is backfill screen evidence which backfill_cannot_promote states can never promote.

findings.claim: sl-5pct is the top arm on win rate at screen_wr=55.055 vs control 49.772.
findings.problem: Its EV moves the wrong way: screen_ev=0.011 versus control 0.019, so a +5.22pp win-rate gain comes with lower EV per trade — the exact signature G-08 and G-17 already recorded, that stop/threshold moves are a win-rate dial that does not lift net EV because loss size balloons. The stated objective requires both win rate AND EV per trade net of fees and slippage, and no slippage haircut (0.12% per extra fill) appears applied to any screen_ev figure shown. The arm is being ranked on half the objective.

findings.claim: placebo_inert is green with detail 'discordant pairs b=0 c=0 — placebo cannot change any decision'.
findings.problem: b=0/c=0 with min_price=1e-12 shows the placebo is a null parameter, but it therefore tests nothing about the arena's false-positive rate. An inert placebo that provably cannot differ from control cannot detect a scoring bug, a pairing error or an EV-accounting artifact — it will read 0/0 whether the pipeline is sound or broken. The checkbox is green for a reason that does not establish what the check is named for.

findings.claim: kernel_agreement is green at 179/184 live setups reproduced (97.3%), above the stated 90% drift bar.
findings.problem: The five misses are not random: four of the five are the same coin (BOME, at 2026-07-26T17:31, 2026-07-26T02:03, 2026-07-25T16:33, 2026-07-23T14:48). A coin-clustered miss pattern is a systematic kernel-vs-bot divergence on one name, not sampling noise, and the aggregate percentage hides it. Combined with the declared +0.55pp pump-size read difference across 184 matched setups, the arena is scoring a slightly different population than the bot trades — failure mode PM — while the green check is read as agreement.
